name: Dead Lifts
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Bend down and grip bar just outside legs.
Keep chest up, back straight, and core engaged.
Drive through heels, extending hips and knees.
Stand tall with shoulders back, then reverse to lower.
tips: Initiate by pushing the floor away
Keep bar close to your body throughout
safety: Don't round your back under load
Start with light weight to master form
